---
title: T5b - Interventions (detecting typhoid carriers)
jupyter: python3
---


This tutorial shows how to use a routine diagnostic intervention, that administers a test (the product) to a fraction of the eligible population. Here, people are screened as they become _acute_ (`on=`, an event: here, the onset of acute infection). Who is eligible can instead be given as a condition (`where=`, e.g. `where=typhoid.chronic` with `interval=ss.years(1)` for yearly rounds of screening of chronic carriers).

The sensitivity of the diagnostic product (the test), understood as the probability of receiving a positive diagnostic given that the individual is infected, can be set when instantiating the product. Each result (`positive` and `negative`) is an event that a following step, such as `ss.treat(..., on=screening.positive)`, can be triggered by.


```{python}
import starsim as ss
import typhoidsim as ty

# Define high-level simulation parameters
pars = dict(
    start    = 2000,          # Starting year
    dur      = ss.years(2),   # Duration of the simulation
    dt       = ss.weeks(1),   # Timestep of 1 week
    verbose  = 0,             # Do not print details of the run
)

# The population
ppl = ss.People(50_000)

# Person to person transmission
random_p2p = ss.RandomNet(n_contacts=10)

# The disease
typhoid = ty.Typhoid(tppi=0.1, init_seroprev=0.8, init_prev=0.001)

# Create an intervention that screens symptomatic (acute) individuals as they become acute.
# The diagnostic product is a test that is equivalent to a blood test with sensitivity of 0.65
blood_test   = ss.Diagnostic(sensitivity=0.65)
screen_acute = ss.screen(blood_test, who=typhoid.onset.to(typhoid.acute), coverage=0.3, start=2001, name='screening') # Screen 30% of acute individuals, starting in 2001


# Now create the sim with the intervention
sim = ss.Sim(pars=pars, 
             people=ppl, 
             networks=random_p2p,
             diseases=typhoid, 
             interventions=screen_acute)
sim.run()
```

```{python}
sim.plot()
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

res = sim.results.screening

plt.figure()
plt.plot(sim.timevec, res.delivered, label='New screened acute carriers')
plt.plot(sim.timevec, res.positive, label='New screened who tested positive')

plt.axvline(x=ss.date(2001), color='k', ls='--')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| collapsed: false
import numpy as np

positivity = np.divide(res.positive, res.delivered, out=np.full(len(res.delivered), np.nan), where=res.delivered > 0)

plt.figure()
plt.plot(sim.timevec, positivity, label='Instantaneous positivity')

plt.axvline(x=ss.date(2001), color='k', ls='--')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```
